item.title: McLaren unveils special Artura Spider MCL39 to mark 10th Constructors’ title
item.description: McLaren have unveiled a special edition Artura Spider MCL39, celebrating the F1 team’s tenth Constructor’s Championship in 2025, with McLaren driver also Lando Norris took home his maiden Championship title.

item.title: Why Dreamliner departed from London with possible fuel switch defect, UK watchdog asks Air India
item.description: The UK CAA has demanded an urgent explanation from Air India after a Boeing Dreamliner departed London with a potentially faulty fuel switch, later grounded in India. Concerns center on airworthiness protocols and a “root-cause analysis” of the critical component. Air India faces possible regulatory action if a full explanation isn’t provided within seven days, highlighting vital aviation safety standards.

item.title: FCC accepts SpaceX application for mega orbital data centre constellation
item.description: SpaceX has filed a proposal with the FCC to launch up to one million satellites to support space-based data centres powered by solar energy. The regulator has opened the plan for public comments, starting a process that could reshape how future AI infrastructure is built.

item.title: Jupiter is smaller, flatter than previously believed
item.description: NASA’s Juno spacecraft has precisely measured the size and shape of Jupiter. The Gas Giant is smaller and flatter than previously believed.

item.title: Dhikala Zone in Jim Corbett: Most popular safari destination in Uttarakhand with best wildlife sightings
item.description: Dhikala Zone in Jim Corbett National Park is the most popular safari destination in Uttarakhand. Known as the heart of Corbett, it offers tiger sightings, vast grasslands, diverse wildlife, and rare opportunities to stay inside the forest, attracting tourists and wildlife enthusiasts from everywhere.

item.title: NASA astronauts to fly to ISS, Moon with latest smartphones
item.description: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman has revealed that NASA astronauts will be flying to space with the latest smartphones in upcoming missions. The qualification process has been streamlined and sped up.

item.title: J&K government mandates registration for coaching centres, set strict fee, safety norms
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir has notified new rules to regulate private coaching centres making registration mandatory and enforcing strict norms on fees, safety, infrastructure and student welfare. The framework aims to bring transparency, protect students’ interests and ensure accountability in the coaching sector across the Union Territory.

item.title: Delhi-NCR might see EV-only car registration from 2030 under draft plan
item.description: Owing to rising concerns of air quality in Delhi-NCR which has seen a rise in sales inhalers and nebulisers as well, the Commission of Air Quality Management set up an expert panel that has drafted a roadmap which could change the region’s vehicle landscape in next two decades.

item.description: Netflix has dropped the teaser for Boyfriend On Demand, starring Jisoo and Seo In-guk. The futuristic rom-com explores virtual dating, loneliness and unexpected emotions. From the expected plot to release date and cast details, here’s everything you need to know. Read on.
